hints.content: A dilation by a scale factor of $3$ will map $D'$ to a point $3$ times as far from the origin as point $D$ was, but in the same direction.

Point $D$ is $\purpleC{2}$ units left from the origin.

The image $D'$ will be $3(\purpleC{2})=6$ units left and $3(\maroonD{0})=0$ units up from the origin.
